text: 陈茂波在网志表示，国庆在即，这些年来国家始终坚定推进改革开放，以高质量发展引领中国式现代化不断迈向新阶段。国家拥有门类齐全、结构完备的产业体系、超大规模的消费市场，为香港发挥自身优势、融入和服务国家发展大局以及自身的长足发展提供更广阔舞台。他指出，人工智能发展为经济增添动力。受人工智能和相关电子产品需求带动，本港8月整体商品出口货值按年上升53%，首八个月合计上升42.5%。按政府经济顾问的最新评估，政府有信心达到全年GDP增长3.5%至4.5%的经修订预测目标。（香港政府新闻网）
text_en: In his blog, Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that with National Day approaching, the country has consistently advanced reform and opening up over the years, leading Chinese-style modernization to new stages through high-quality development. The country has a comprehensive and well-structured industrial system and a super-large consumer market, providing a broader stage for Hong Kong to leverage its own advantages, integrate into and serve the country's development, and achieve its own long-term development. He pointed out that AI development adds momentum to the economy. Driven by demand for AI and related electronic products, Hong Kong's overall merchandise export value rose 53% year-on-year in August, and by 42.5% in the first eight months combined. According to the latest assessment by the government's economic adviser, the government is confident of meeting its revised full-year GDP growth forecast of 3.5% to 4.5%. (Hong Kong Government News)
